lines.zh: 月影轻移，月光闪烁如梦。
lines.en: Lady Luna moves, moonlight glows dreamlike.
Lady Luna glides in moonlight.
She leaves moon shadows in the night.
Under moonlight, Lady Luna moves gracefully.
Lady Luna wanders in moonlight.

lines.zh: 月光映照下，月影缓缓行走。
lines.en: Lady Luna walks slowly under moonlight.

lines.zh: 她穿过月色如织的夜空。
lines.en: She weaves through the moonlit night.

lines.zh: 月影行走在月光的怀抱里。
lines.en: Lady Luna walks in the moon's embrace.
Lady Luna moves lightly in the moonlight.
Lady Luna strolls in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影静静伫立，月光下显神秘。
lines.en: Lady Luna stands still, mysterious under moonlight.
Lady Luna stands still, like a lunar deity.
Lady Luna gazes under moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影静静守候在月色里。
lines.en: Lady Luna waits quietly in the moonlight.
Lady Luna pauses, moonlight her companion.

lines.zh: 月影伫立，月光下显神秘。
lines.en: Lady Luna stands, mysterious under moonlight.

lines.zh: 她静静地立于月色之中。
lines.en: She stands quietly in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影静静站立，宛如月神。
lines.en: Lady Luna stands quietly, like a lunar deity.

lines.zh: 月影静静等候在月色里。
lines.en: Lady Luna waits quietly in the moonlight.
Acid blocks harden at my feet.
When I'm red, come at me with a blade.
When I'm green, only arrows reach me.
Moonlight settles into a path.
Eight thousand points of life. Grind it down.
I am counting the moon's phases.
The edge of night is mine.

lines.zh: 月影注视着你，月光中透出杀机。
lines.en: Lady Luna looks at you, danger in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影紧盯着你，月光如剑。
lines.en: Lady Luna stares at you, moonlight like a blade.

lines.zh: 月影的目光如月，闪烁着寒意。
lines.en: Lady Luna's gaze, like the moon, icy.

lines.zh: 月影锁定目标，月光中显现杀意。
lines.en: Lady Luna locks on, danger in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影的目光如星辰，凝视着你。
lines.en: Lady Luna's gaze, like stars, fixed on you.

lines.zh: 月影盯住你，月光下显凶兆。
lines.en: Lady Luna fixes on you, ominous under moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影目光锐利，月光中透出威胁。
lines.en: Lady Luna's sharp gaze, threat in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影目光如月，凝视着你。
lines.en: Lady Luna's gaze, like the moon, fixed on you.

lines.zh: 月影注视着你，月光中透出凶兆。
lines.en: Lady Luna looks at you, ominous under moonlight.

lines.zh: 月影的目光如月，凝视着你。
lines.en: Lady Luna's gaze, like the moon, fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你抬头那一下，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the moment you looked up.

lines.zh: 月光把你的影子拉长了。
lines.en: Moonlight stretched your shadow long.

lines.zh: 月影的月光黯淡了下去。
lines.en: Lady Luna's moonlight dims.
Shadows tremble.
Weak under moonlight.
Luna's glow fades.
Her moonlight is no longer bright.
Shadows sway.
Moonlight dims.
Her moonlight is no longer dazzling.
Lady Luna appears weary.
Moonlight is weak.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒吸引了我，月影女士。
lines.en: The light on you attracts me, Lady Luna.

lines.zh: 我的月影酸块中蕴藏了无尽能量。
lines.en: My moon acid contains infinite energy.

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则你会后悔的。
lines.en: Don't get too close, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你的勇气让我感到兴奋。
lines.en: Your courage excites me.

lines.zh: 我的激光会带你飞向天空。
lines.en: My lasers will take you to the sky.
You're so alluring under the moonlight.
You can't escape my control.
While I glow red, only fists reach me.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我充满活力。
lines.en: Your presence energizes me.

lines.zh: 月光下，我们是完美的猎物与捕食者。
lines.en: Under the moonlight, we're the perfect prey and predator.

lines.zh: 你的力量激起了我的怒火。
lines.en: Your strength infuriates me.
You crushed my acid block.
Get out of my way, or you'll get hurt.
Your intrusion angers me.
Don't touch my acid blocks; they explode.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，都留下月影酸。
lines.en: Wherever I walk, moon-acid follows.
You're blocking my attack.

lines.zh: 你的干扰激起了我的怒气。
lines.en: Your interference angers me.
You're hindering my movement.
You're blocking my exit.
Few of my kind see me.
I seek my mate.
I long to find my own kind.
With me, you'll be invincible.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类是艰难的。
lines.en: Finding my own kind is difficult.

lines.zh: 我的同类总是那么遥远。
lines.en: My own kind is always distant.

lines.zh: 我期待与我的同类相遇。
lines.en: I look forward to meeting my own kind.

lines.zh: 我的同类很少能存活下来。
lines.en: My own kind rarely survive.
I seek my own kind.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类是我的使命。
lines.en: Finding my own kind is my mission.

lines.zh: 月影女士发出嘶嘶声，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Lady Luna hisses, sending a chill down your spine.

lines.zh: 酸块从她脚下浮现，指向你。
lines.en: Acid blocks appear beneath her, pointing at you.

lines.zh: 她的月光令你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Her moonlight fills you with fear.

lines.zh: 月影女士召唤出一束月光，刺向你。
lines.en: Lady Luna calls forth a beam of moonlight, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛闪烁着红色的光芒。
lines.en: Her eyes glow with a red light.

lines.zh: 她挥动着爪子，准备一击致命。
lines.en: She swings her claws, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 她周围的月光开始扭曲。
lines.en: The moonlight around her begins to distort.
The ground rips open, launching you into the air.

lines.zh: 月影女士的声音低沉而威严。
lines.en: Lady Luna’s voice is deep and authoritative.

lines.zh: 月光凝结成激光，射向目标。
lines.en: Moonlight condenses into a laser, aimed at the target.
You are in her sights.
Her eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 月影女士的影子开始追踪你。
lines.en: Lady Luna’s shadow tracks you.
Her body starts moving.

lines.zh: 月光在她身边形成一个光环。
lines.en: Moonlight forms a halo around her.
She prepares to attack.
Acid blocks gather around her.

lines.zh: 她的姿态变得更为主动。
lines.en: She becomes more aggressive.
Moonlight starts to focus.
Her claws swing through the air.
You stepped on my acid block.
The ground under you is heating up.
This blow will blow you skyward.
No fall protection, I take it?
The moonlight has chosen you.
Fifty points of force. Brace yourself.
Your armor cannot stop the moon.

lines.zh: 你站的那块酸，已经亮了。
lines.en: The acid beneath you is already glowing.

lines.zh: 月影女士锁定你的位置。
lines.en: Lady Luna locks onto your position.
Her eyes glow green.
Moonlight swirls around her.
Acid blocks fire lasers.

lines.zh: 她的动作变得更加迅速。
lines.en: Her movements become quicker.

lines.zh: 月影酸块在她身边生成。
lines.en: Moon acid forms around her.
She begins to chant a spell.
Her claws are ready to strike.

lines.zh: 月影女士的能量在增长。
lines.en: Lady Luna’s energy grows.
Moonlight converges on her.
Watch my color. Don't swing blindly.
I'm red now. Come closer.
I'm green now. Draw your bow.
The acid block's light is aimed at you.
The laser comes from the ground.
Don't stand in that acid trail.
Acid grows along my trail.
You are under my moonlight.
The next beam is for you.
My shadow moves before I do.
Lady Luna swings, sword like the moon.
Sword shadows flash, the earth trembles.
Lady Luna rushes, sword glow blinding.
Sword shadows pass, leaving lunar marks.
Sword in moonlight, one slash divides the air.
Sword shadow like a ribbon, slicing through the air.
Lady Luna swings, sword qi chills.
Sword like a moon wheel, slicing through the air.
Sword in moonlight, lunar shadows cross.
Sword shadows in moonlight, moonlit dance.
Burst and take the dirt with you.
You're not flying. You're blown up.
A muffled blast below — look at the sky.
Don't blame the ground when you land.
Lady Luna descends, moonlight spills.
Moon messenger, silently arrives.
Moonlight covers the earth.
Lady Luna appears, moonlight turns cold.
Lady Luna's shadow, moon essence.
Lady Luna descends, moon messenger.
Moonlight covers this land.
Lady Luna descends, moon guardian.
Moon messenger, night sprite.
Moonlight, guardian appears.
An acid trail stretches behind me.
The moon gave me the night.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方都留着酸。
lines.en: Acid lingers where I walk.
Red or green — pick a side.
Eight thousand points. Don't start counting.
Tonight the ground belongs to me.
Moonlight hardens on my blade.
I step down from the moon.
Do you hear the ground cracking?
I preside over this moonlight.
Lady Luna is consumed by fire.
Lady Luna falls from the sky.
Lady Luna drowns.

lines.zh: 月影被大爆炸震得摇晃。
lines.en: Lady Luna is shaken by the explosion.
Lady Luna is hit by a projectile.
Lady Luna is hit by magic.
Lady Luna is weakened by hunger.
Lady Luna is struck by lightning.
Lady Luna is consumed by darkness.
